benefits.titleZh: 談論課堂、會議或活動後留下來
benefits.titleEn: Talk about staying after a lesson, meeting or activity
benefits.zh: wait behind 可以表示其他人離開後，某人仍然留下來。
benefits.en: Wait behind lets you explain that somebody remains after the other people have left.

benefits.titleZh: 描述在不同情境中服侍別人
benefits.titleEn: Describe serving people in different situations
benefits.zh: wait on 常用於餐廳和用餐情境；wait upon 則可能出現在正式場合、古老故事和歷史劇中。
benefits.en: Wait on is useful in restaurants and meals, while wait upon may appear in formal settings, old stories and historical dramas.

benefits.titleZh: 談論尚未到達的人物、消息和結果
benefits.titleEn: Talk about people, messages and results that have not arrived
benefits.zh: wait on 可以表示等候某人、送貨、回覆、價格或決定。
benefits.en: Wait on can describe waiting for a person, delivery, reply, price or decision.

benefits.titleZh: 描述安全等候，直到困難情況結束
benefits.titleEn: Describe staying safely until a difficult situation ends
benefits.zh: wait something out 可用來談論暴風雨、大雨、濃霧、塞車和其他暫時性問題。
benefits.en: Wait something out is useful when talking about storms, heavy rain, fog, traffic jams and other temporary problems.
